summary: Narrow iteration 5 verification of the build-missing fallback branch added to /app/backend/server.py, plus regression check on GET /, /api/health, and WS /api/ws/heading. All checks pass.

code_review_of_fallback.condition: _build_dir = ROOT_DIR.parent / 'frontend' / 'build'; if _build_dir.is_dir(): mount StaticFiles; else: register @app.get('/') fallback returning JSON
code_review_of_fallback.verdict: Correct. Fallback route is only registered inside the else-branch, so it never shadows static serving when the build exists. Returned JSON contains the required keys: error, expected_at, fix. expected_at uses absolute path via str(_build_dir).
notes: Build dir currently present in container; StaticFiles mounted at '/', fallback branch not registered (verified by GET / returning text/html of index.html, not JSON).

Minor (non-blocking): app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware,...) is called AFTER app.mount('/',...) and app.include_router(...). Starlette adds middleware to the outer stack regardless of order, so it still applies, but by convention middleware is registered before routes/mounts. Existing behavior unchanged from prior iterations.

verifications.GET /: 200 text/html; body begins with <!doctype html> (index.html served from frontend/build) — static serving unaffected by new fallback
verifications.GET /api/health: 200 {status: ok, simulator: true, last_packet_age_sec: 0.03, stale: false, heading present, packets increasing}
verifications.WS /api/ws/heading: Streams JSON frames containing heading, rot, cog, sog at ~10Hz (3 consecutive frames received in <1s)

critical_code_review_comments: CORSMiddleware is added after routes/mount; harmless but non-idiomatic. Consider moving app.add_middleware(...) call above app.include_router and the static mount for clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 only validated the new build-missing fallback branch (code review) and re-ran a light regression (GET /, /api/health, WS). Per main agent instruction, frontend/build was NOT deleted to exercise the else-branch at runtime; static code review confirms correctness.
